data.cultural_impact: The name Fulbright has its roots in the English language and doesn't carry any inherent cultural meaning on its own. However, it is worth noting that the name gained significant cultural impact due to the distinguished career of J. William Fulbright, an American politician, and diplomat. Fulbright is renowned for his efforts in establishing the Fulbright Scholarship Program which is known for promoting international educational and cultural exchanges. Since its inception in 1946, the Fulbright Program has enabled countless individuals from various countries to study, conduct research, and teach in the United States, thus fostering mutual understanding and collaboration between nations.
